sections.title: Helyett: instead of
sections.content: *Helyett* means "instead of" and follows the noun, which does not change. The thing you choose instead takes its usual ending: *Kávé helyett teát kérek.* (Instead of coffee I would like tea.) *Busz helyett gyalog megyek.* (Instead of the bus I walk.) *Hús helyett halat eszem.* (Instead of meat I eat fish.)

sections.title: Helyett
rows: on foot instead of the bus
the park instead of the cinema

sections.title: Compare the three words
sections.content: *Nélkül* takes something away: *cukor nélkül*. *Helyett* swaps one thing for another: *kávé helyett tea*. *Felé* gives a direction: *a park felé*.

items.english: Instead of coffee I would like tea.
Instead of the bus I walk.
Instead of meat I eat fish.
Instead of the cinema we are going to the park.
Instead of a film I listen to music.

sections.content: Only the thing you choose gets *-t*: *kávé helyett teát*, not *kávét helyett*. The word before *helyett* stays bare.
